strings.Все участники и документы дела вымышлены: All participants and documents are fictional. Customs release and subsequent delivery are confirmed. There is a delivery damage report and an inventory, but the responsible party and extent of liability are not established. International tracing is not reduced to a general thirty-day period. You prepare materials and proposed actions rather than replace an authorised person's decision. The calendar task concerns the authority's formal response, not actual resolution of the problem.

strings.Для этого упражнения закреплён профиль и: This exercise uses a fixed calculation profile: start on the day after the initial event, roll the deadline forward, and use the federal five-day week. Do not automatically apply it to other procedures.

strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.

strings.Определите последний день ответа органа: Determine the last day for the authority to reply to the registered appeal. No extension applies. This is not a deadline for fulfilling the substantive request or correcting the register.
